'''Marc Oliver Rieger''' (born September 22, 1974) is a German mathematician and finance professor. His research covers the areas of [[Behavioral economics|behavioural finance]], [[Decision theory|decision]] and [[game theory]], [[derivative (finance)|financial derivatives]], and calculus of variation. 

Together with [[Thorsten Hens]] and [[Mei Wang]], he was one of the authors of the INTRA survey (International Test on Risk Attitudes) that collected risk and time preferences in 53 countries worldwide leading to various follow-up studies by other researchers and practitioners and media coverage by leading newspapers in Germany and elsewhere.<ref>"Die Geduldsprobe" Süddeutschen Zeitung, 2. March, 2016</ref><ref>"Kaum scharf aufs schnelle Geld: Deutsche sind in Geldfragen am geduldigsten?" Frankfurter Allgemeine (FAZ), 12. January, 2016</ref><ref>"Sparen statt Kredit: Sind die Deutschen das geduldigste Volk?" Wirtschafts Woche, 6. January, 2016</ref><ref>"Die Angst vor Verlusten" Süddeutschen Zeitung, 14. May, 2014</ref><ref>"Three behavioral biases that can affect your investment performance" forbes.com, 21 December 2011.</ref>

== Biography ==
Rieger is Professor of Banking and Finance at the [[University of Trier]], [[Germany]], since 2010,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uni-trier.de/index.php?id=33328|title=Home|website=Uni Trier|accessdate=21 May 2019|archive-date=7 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190707171149/https://www.uni-trier.de/index.php%3Fid%3D33328|url-status=dead}}</ref> and Director of the [[Confucius Institute]] of the [[University of Trier]] since 2018.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uni-trier.de/index.php?id=41946|title=Unser Team|website=Uni Trier|accessdate=21 May 2019|archive-date=13 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190413021424/https://www.uni-trier.de/index.php%3Fid%3D41946|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2018, he was also adjunct professor at [[National Chengchi University]], [[Taipei]], [[Taiwan]] and in 2019 guest professor at the [[University of Zurich]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bf.uzh.ch/de/persons/rieger-marc_oliver/teaching|title=Prof. Dr. Marc Oliver Rieger|website=Bf.uzh.ch|accessdate=21 May 2019|archive-date=13 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190413021423/https://www.bf.uzh.ch/de/persons/rieger-marc_oliver/teaching|url-status=dead}}</ref> Since 2019, he is core member of the research group "Quantitative Finance and Risk Analysis",<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uni-trier.de/index.php?id=69078|title=Willkommen|website=Uni Trier|accessdate=21 May 2019|archive-date=13 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190413021424/https://www.uni-trier.de/index.php?id=69078|url-status=dead}}</ref> and project leader of the research cluster "Globalization and Re-Nationalization,"<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uni-trier.de/index.php?id=69082|title=Teilprojekt|website=Uni Trier|accessdate=21 May 2019}}</ref> both financed by the research initiative of the state of [[Rheinland-Pfalz]].

Rieger studied mathematics at [[University of Konstanz]] from 1993 to 1998, and obtained a PhD at [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences]], [[Leipzig]], in 2001, under the supervision of [[Stefan Müller (mathematician)|Stefan Müller]]. He worked as research scholar and postdoc at [[Carnegie Mellon University]], [[Scuola Normale Superiore]], [[University of Zürich]] and [[ETH Zürich]].

== Selected publications ==
=== INTRA survey ===
* Wolfgang Breuer, Marc Oliver Rieger, & K. Can Soypak (2014) [http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0378426614000557 The behavioral foundations of corporate dividend policy a cross-country analysis]. Journal of Banking and Finance, 42, 247-265
* Marc Oliver Rieger, Mei Wang, & Thorsten Hens (2015) [http://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/abs/10.1287/mnsc.2013.1869 Risk preferences around the world]. Management Science, 61(3), 637-648
* Mei Wang, Marc O. Rieger, & Thorsten Hens (2016) [https://www.researchgate.net/publication/288701474_How_Time_Preferences_Differ_Evidence_from_53_Countries How time preferences differ: Evidence from 53 countries]. Journal of Economic Psychology, 52, 115-135
* Marc Oliver Rieger, Mei Wang, & Thorsten Hens (2016) [https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11238-016-9582-8 Estimating cumulative prospect theory parameters from an international survey]. Theory and Decision, 17, 1-30.

=== Books ===
* ''[https://www.springer.com/de/book/9783662496862 Financial Economics: A concise Introduction to Classical and Behavioural Finance]'' by Thorsten Hens and Marc O Rieger, Springer Verlag, Heidelberg, Deutschland, 2nd edition (2016). {{ISBN|978-3-662-49688-6}}
* ''[https://www.worldscientific.com/worldscibooks/10.1142/11813 Cultural Finance]'' by Thorsten Hens, Marc Oliver Rieger, and Mei Wang, World Scientific. {{ISBN|978-981-121-976-4}}

=== Other topics ===

* Marc Oliver Rieger, Enrico De Giorgi, & Thorsten Hens (2010) [http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0304406810000534 Financial Market Equilibria with Cumulative Prospect Theory], ''Journal of Mathematical Economics'', 46(5), 633-651
* Marc Oliver Rieger (2011) [http://www.springerlink.com/content/k5r6125653227x83/ Co-monotonicity of optimal investments and the design of structural financial products]{{Dead link|date=March 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}, ''Finance and Stochastics'', 15(1),  27-55
* Marc Oliver Rieger (2014) [http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0304406813001055 Evolutionary stability of prospect theory preferences], ''Journal of Mathematical Economics'', 50, 1-11.
